forYou.name: Sunny & Luna pumpkin gnocchi
forYou.why: You haven't had this before. Pumpkin gnocchi pan-fries in 5 minutes. Serve with brown butter and sage, or spinach and parmesan, for a quick veggie night.

forYou.name: Flawsome! juice
forYou.why: New at Ocado this month. It's pressed from wonky fruit that would otherwise be wasted, with no added sugar. Worth a try instead of the usual juice.
